action: Taipower says it will keep strict control and strengthen cybersecurity protection. General advice: operators of substation SCADA should check for exposed remote access.
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its publication day, 2026-11-23.
exec: A forum seller claims access to a Taiwan substation control system; Taipower says it is not its system.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source; the substation location is not given
org: Taipower (named; says the system is not theirs)
plain: A forum seller says they can access the control system of a Taiwan high-voltage substation. Taipower says the system is not built or run by it or its contractors.
summary: According to TechNews, threat intelligence firm S2W disclosed that a forum seller claims access to the SCADA system of a Taiwan high-voltage substation. Taipower said, as TechNews reports, that after checking, the system is not one built, operated or maintained by Taipower or its contractors. The seller's claim is unverified.
title: Forum seller claims SCADA access to a Taiwan substation; Taipower says not its system

validation.note: Single publisher (TechNews); S2W's report and the forum post were not read; seller's claim unconfirmed.

review.note: Compared title, summary, claimed status, S2W attribution, Taipower statement and action with the TechNews article; single-source note accurate
